query.statement: SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, PLANT_ID, CURRENT_STATE_ID, STATE_CHANGED_AT, STATE_VERSION FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_STATE WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID

SELECT HIST_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, FROM_STATE, TO_STATE, SET_STATE, CHANGED_AT, CHANGED_BY, REASON, SOURCE_TYPE FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_STATE_HISTORY WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY CHANGED_AT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT ALARM_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_CODE, ALARM_NAME, ALARM_LEVEL, OCCURRED_AT, CLEARED_AT, ELAPSED_SECONDS FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_ALARM WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@alarmLevel IS NULL OR ALARM_LEVEL = @alarmLevel) ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, COUNT(*) AS ALARM_COUNT, MAX(OCCURRED_AT) AS LAST_OCCURRED_AT FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_ALARM GROUP BY EQUIPMENT_ID ORDER BY ALARM_COUNT DESC, LAST_OCCURRED_AT DESC LIMIT 10
